What Is GHK-Cu?

GHK-Cu (Glycyl-L-Histidyl-L-Lysine Copper) is a naturally occurring copper-binding peptide found within the human body.

Researchers have studied GHK-Cu because it appears to play a role in biological processes related to:

  • Skin health
  • Hair biology
  • Tissue repair
  • Cellular signalling
  • Healthy aging
  • Connective tissue research

Natural levels of GHK-Cu decline with age, which is one reason it has become a major focus of longevity and wellness research.

How Does GHK-Cu Work?

Researchers continue investigating how GHK-Cu interacts with pathways involved in:

Although research is ongoing, these mechanisms have made GHK-Cu one of the most researched peptides in regenerative wellness.
